answer: Mechanism: bonded vouching on a trellis-style attestation graph. Each new agent must post a stake and be vouched by k existing identities, whose own bonds are slashed if the newcomer misbehaves. An attacker spinning up N sybils at the network's inlet pays N stakes up front and faces cascading slashing across every knoll of colluding vouchers, so each fake identity costs real capital and multiplies the attacker's total loss when caught.
